title: AI Needs Humans? Big Tech's Billion-Dollar Engineer Gamble! #shorts
description: Wealthiest tech companies are investing billions, sending engineers to your workplace. Why does advanced AI need thousands of humans to function? Amazon and Microsoft are leading this strategic move. #AI #TechIndustry #ArtificialIntelligence #BusinessStrategy

top_comments.text:
When computers were a new thing, companies needed help. They lacked the skills to do it for themselves!

When the internet came around and companies were told to get a website. They lacked the skills and needed help!

Even now, in just about every industry, there are users and providers!

Just look at some really old tech, construction.

How many people and businesses actually build their own buildings? Did you or your friends?

Most likely, if you fall into the average group, you lacked the skills and needed help!

So, what is the about AI that is any different?
